title: Unit Event — The Legend Still Vivid — Episode4 Where the Legend Was Born

meta.Episode: Episode4 — Where the Legend Was Born
meta.Event Outline: Thanks to their experience of going camping together, VBS has learned the importance of having a shared vision when they sing. Kohane asks Taiga if there's a way for them to establish a shared vision of RAD WEEKEND without any footage of the event to go off of.

rows.Line: Saturday
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh! Good morning, everyone!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Morning, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Good morning. You're here early.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hm? We agreed to meet at eleven, right? But we're all here thirty minutes early...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know why!
We were all looking forward to today so much that we couldn't help but wake up early! Even Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, we're not little kids and this isn't some field trip.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Actually, she might not be far off.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Quiet, you...
The point is that I never thought I'd get to see this place again.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They must've really been looking forward to this day if they're this openly anxious about it.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can't wait either...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm finally getting a chance to see a part of the reason why An and Shinonome want to surpass RAD WEEKEND as much as they do...!)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys are early.
We weren't supposed to meet for a while, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello, Taiga!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course we're here early!
Two of us at least never thought we'd ever get to see COL again!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you for creating this incredible opportunity for us today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We definitely wouldn't have been able to do anything like this on our own.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Heh. I'm glad you're happy, but this is about all I can show you guys at this point...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: The owner's waiting for us there, so let's start making our way over.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Here it is.
The basement for this building's COL.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa, talk about a blast from the past... I totally remember lining up here to get in, and how the line spilled out onto the street...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, and three years have passed since...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: From the outside, it looks like any of the other dives you can find around here.
Just what exactly are you calling a dive...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Hey, Granny.
See? As happy and healthy as ever, right?

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: I'm the owner of this place, not your “Granny”. Thirty years and you still refuse to learn any manners...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is this person really the owner, An...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, it's her. She used to own and operate a bunch of live houses around here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dad and Uncle Taiga have known her since they were our age.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I had no idea...!
That's so cool.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know, right?
Anyway, long time no see!

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, if it isn't An.
It's nice to see that the girl with a chip on her shoulder's grown up so much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Heehee!
It's nice to see you too!

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Ah, you must be the one who's been aching to see my dive.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, hello...!
My name is Kohane Azusawa. I'm on the same team as An!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: W-We heard that you closed this place a long time ago, so thank you for being so kind as to show us around like this...!

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line:
I don't mind.
I've been coming here from time to time to keep it clean.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Well, I'm going to have to hand this place over to someone at some point... Not only that...

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: I'm sure actually being here will help you remember that night better.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That night... Is she referring to RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Probably.
Especially since this is where RAD WEEKEND happened.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It was probably the event she was looking for to cap off the history of this place.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So RAD WEEKEND meant a lot to the owner of this venue as well...)

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Alright, let's head inside.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(It's really where RAD WEEKEND happened...
I have to absorb as much as I can...!)
se_event_bridal_2021_001
COL

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-It's so dark...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Our eyes haven't adjusted yet since it's so bright out today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just don't slip and fall, alright?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
He's right.
We need to watch where we walk.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Give me a second to turn on the floodlights.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Ah, here we go...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So this is where RAD WEEKEND happened...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's so much smaller than I remember.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Probably because we were kids.
I'm guessing we were both a lot shorter back then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. That means we've grown up a lot since.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, the stage is literally right in front of us...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (An and Shinonome seem completely awestruck...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This is really it...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Whoa!
This is really the venue for RAD WEEKEND?!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Eep...!
L-Len?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... N-Nothing!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Len, you need to be quiet.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <O-Oh, right...!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane? Is something... Ah...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Hehe. We're here.
Sorry, we just couldn't wait.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, they'll see you if you keep jumping out like that. Wait until we give you the signal.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Okay, I'm sorry...
I'll be careful from now on.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We promise to stay hidden, so please let us see.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I suppose you'll stay out of sight as long as you stay in Azusawa's pocket.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll try to position myself so that you both can get a good look.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Great!
Thanks, Kohane!>
